tools.name: get_bundles
tools.description: Community Center bundles the farmer can see: each room's bundles with items still needed and items already given. Returns why if bundles are not visible yet or the farm chose Joja.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: This season's calendar: festivals and villager birthdays with their days, plus today's and tomorrow's events and tomorrow's weather forecast.

tools.name: get_crops
tools.description: Crops planted on a map (default Farm, including garden pots): grouped by crop with counts that are ready to harvest, need water, or are dead, and the days until the next harvest. Set includeTiles for tile positions.

includeTiles.description: List tile positions for each group. Default false.

tools.name: get_gift_tastes
tools.description: The gifts a villager loves, likes, dislikes and hates, from the game's data. Universal tastes apply on top of these.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: The farmer's backpack: every slot with item name, id, stack, quality and sell price. Slot 0-11 is the toolbar row.

tools.name: get_item_info
tools.description: Look up an item by name or id: type, category, description, sell price, energy and health if edible. For seeds also the crop's seasons, days to grow and regrowth; for crops, which seed grows them.

item.description: Item name (for example 'Parsnip Seeds') or qualified id (for example '(O)472').

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Describe a map: size, exits (warps and doors with their target maps), buildings, NPCs and players present, forage, machines and their output, chests and other notable objects. Defaults to the farmer's current map.

location.description: Map name such as Farm, Town, SeedShop, FarmHouse. Omit for the current map.

includeObjects.description: Include a list of every placed object with its tile (can be long). Default false.

tools.name: get_quests
tools.description: The quest log: each quest's title, description, objectives and days left.

tools.name: get_relationships
tools.description: Every villager the farmer has met: hearts, friendship points, whether talked to today, gifts given today and this week, birthday, relationship status, and current map when known.

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Skill levels, experience points and professions.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Overview of the current moment: whether a save is loaded, date and time, weather, the farmer's money, energy, health, location, tile and held item, and whether the game is in a menu, event or paused. Call this first.

content.text: No gift data for 'Nobody'. Use the villager's name as shown in get_relationships.
